newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds leads UK bank sector rebound.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds leads UK bank sector rebound.

text.p: Lloyds TSB Plc and other leading UK bank stocks rose on Wednesday, recovering from recent losses as U.S. interest rates were left unchanged and Merrill Lynch repeated an "overweight" stance on the sector, dealers said.

Lloyds TSB, down 23p in the past two sessions from the record close of 621p set on May 16, was up 13-1/2p or 2.3 percent at 611-1/2 by 1114 GMT, Barclays Plc rose 8p at 12.13 stg, HSBC Holdings Plc gained 10-1/2p at 18.00-1/2 stg and National Westminster Bank Plc firmed 7-1/2p at 793-1/2.
